descriptions.english: While you have 300 or more [coin], unit cards get +3 [attack] and +5 [health].
descriptions.french: Tant que vous avez au moins 300 [coin], les cartes d’unité ont +3 [attack] et +5 [health].

descriptions.portuguese: Enquanto você tiver 300 ou mais [coin], cartas de unidade ganham +3 [attack] e +5 [health].

lore_tooltips.english: The worse the contract, the better the terms.

lore_tooltips.russian: Чем хуже договор, тем лучше условия.
lore_tooltips.portuguese: Quanto pior o contrato, melhores os termos.
lore_tooltips.spanish: Cuanto peor es el contrato, mejores son las condiciones.
